valid_transition_rules.name: no_promotion_after_invalidated_without_restoration_v1
valid_transition_rules.statement: An invalidated object may not be promoted unless a RESTORED event with recovery evidence exists.

valid_transition_rules.name: no_superseded_object_as_active_support_v1
valid_transition_rules.statement: A superseded object may not remain active support unless explicitly marked legacy-compatible.

valid_transition_rules.name: no_confidence_band_jump_without_source_event_v1
valid_transition_rules.statement: Confidence bands may not jump upward without a source result package, validation event, or rerigor endorsement event.

valid_transition_rules.name: no_rigor endorsement_restore_without_runtime_recheck_v1
valid_transition_rules.statement: Tool rigor endorsement may not be restored after runtime drift without binary/provenance recheck.
